The shipped model corpus

Source: R/corpus.R
zupkpmx_corpus.Rd

Lists the models that ship with zupkpmx. Each entry is one model written in every format that can hold it, with the typical-subject predictions the formats must agree on. The corpus is the package's test suite and a set of known-equivalent translations to compare against.

Usage

zupkpmx_corpus()

Value

A data frame with one row per entry, ordered by id:

id

The entry's name, also its directory name.

title

A one-line description of the model.

structure

The NONMEM ADVAN/TRANS pair it corresponds to.

regimen

The dose route of its predictions: "bolus", "oral" or "infusion".

formats

The formats the entry is written in, comma-separated: "nonmem" (model.ctl), "rxode2" (model-rxode2.R) and "mrgsolve" (model.cpp).

source

Where the model comes from, and its licence.

path

The entry's directory.

Examples

corpus <- zupkpmx_corpus()
corpus[, c("id", "structure", "formats")]
#>                  id      structure                formats
#> 1       onecmt-oral  ADVAN2 TRANS2 nonmem,rxode2,mrgsolve
#> 2   onecmt-oral-lag  ADVAN2 TRANS2 nonmem,rxode2,mrgsolve
#> 3    onecmt-oral-mm        ADVAN13 nonmem,rxode2,mrgsolve
#> 4 threecmt-infusion ADVAN11 TRANS4 nonmem,rxode2,mrgsolve
#> 5      twocmt-bolus  ADVAN3 TRANS4 nonmem,rxode2,mrgsolve
#> 6       twocmt-oral  ADVAN4 TRANS4 nonmem,rxode2,mrgsolve
